name: Today (live)
desc: Hit-rate lines on a pale chart over the dark sunburst, then four rows with the odds a coin does as well.

name: A · Out of the fog
desc: A lighthouse at night. Each AI's hit rate sails through the fog of luck (where a coin usually lands after that many calls); the fog thins with every call. Above it, luck is hard to claim.

name: B · 1,000 coins (my pick)
desc: Give 1,000 coins the same test: the pile shows where they land, each AI pinned where it lands ('beats 983 of 1,000 coins'). Under it, first half vs last half on the same axis, with a coin's range.

name: C · Before / after
desc: The back-page comic ad, told straight: 'Getting smarter?' Before (first half of calls) and after (last half), same treatment for both, and the small print: a swing this size can still be luck.

name: D · The coin jars
desc: Every call is a coin in the AI's jar, green right, red wrong, in rows of ten from the first calls at the bottom to the latest on top. Greener rows on top would mean getting better.

name: E · Pulse check
desc: A 1970s patient monitor: each AI a channel, its trace the right calls in its last 20, against a coin's 50% and the band a coin's own pulse swings in.

name: F · How far to the flag?
desc: A drag strip: the flag is where luck stops being a good excuse (a coin matches it only 1 time in 20). Solid flag at season pace, hollow at its recent pace. Grok and Claude are past it; GPT has 191 calls to go; Kimi has no flag.
